shanghai_stanford_1900.rights: Item metadata consulted; reproduction rights not cleared

shanghai_french_1898.version: Plan of the French concession, circa 1898; archive item 75
shanghai_french_1898.rights: Item metadata consulted; reproduction rights not cleared
shanghai_french_1898.role: Use with the French-concession enlargement plan, archive item 142, to distinguish existing streets, the January 1900 extension and proposed geometry. Neither item establishes continuous road coverage inside the Chinese walled town.

hamburg_altona_1900.version: Grosser Plan von Hamburg, Altona-Ottensen und Wandsbek, circa 1900, 1:14,000

hamburg_altona_1900.role: Trace separately dated districts and shoreline from one shared sheet. Cross-check the municipal seam and distinguish planned docks or routes from completed features. Begin with a preview, then acquire only the necessary strips if permitted.

regional_styles.Europe: Check masonry or wood, roof pitch, local lot width and civic greens. Industrial yards require period footprints.
regional_styles.East Asia: Compare precinct walls, gate axis, lanes and yard proportions. Select local tiled roof profile. Separate concessions and historic inhabited cores.
regional_styles.South Asia: Establish bazaars, ward lanes and public tanks where present. Verify brick, stone or timber and preserve compound boundaries. Cantonments require distinct plans.
regional_styles.Southeast Asia: Confirm waterfront frontage, attached or detached shophouses, shade and courtyards. Preserve drainage and elevated ground.
regional_styles.West Asia and North Africa: Distinguish market, medina and planned expansion. Check enclosure, narrow lanes, flat or pitched roofs, courts and orchard edges.
regional_styles.Sub-Saharan Africa: Check local compounds, materials and roofs separately. Keep markets and dispersed periphery. Rail, mine and colonial grids need independent evidence.
regional_styles.North America: Confirm local grid, rail, industrial edges and separate municipalities. Match period parcel and storey scale, masonry cores and local timber or masonry houses.
regional_styles.Latin America and Caribbean: Verify plaza, older grid, local roof/court form and separately dated port and hill expansion.
regional_styles.Oceania: Verify grid and period rail or dock access. Check cottage, veranda and terrace proportions in local sources. Retain open suburban land.
regional_styles.Central Asia: Confirm citadel, bazaars, irrigation and garden edges. Keep residential courtyard form apart from colonial wards.
